text: With m2 fixed at N=64, seed 21's force peaks at layer 1, the distance layer (margin 0.195). At N=128 both seeds peak at layer 4. What is the layer-1 force margin at N=128 with m2 fixed? Is the N=64 to N=128 drop concentrated in a layer-1 read of 1/r^2 from distance, given that layer-1 distance R2 stays at 0.91-0.92?
